issue: Network port hung on server XYZ
description: The network port on server XYZ has become unresponsive, causing connectivity issues for users.
steps_to_resolve: Step 1: Step 1 - Verify the status of the network port on server XYZ.
Step 2: Step 2 - Check for any recent changes made to the network configuration.
Step 3: Step 3 - Review network logs for any errors or warnings related to server XYZ.
Step 4: Step 4 - Restart the network interface on server XYZ.
Step 5: Step 5 - Test connectivity to the server after restarting the network interface.
Step 6: Step 6 - If the issue persists, check the physical connections to the network port.
Step 7: Step 7 - Replace the network cable if any damage is observed.
Step 8: Step 8 - If the port is still unresponsive, escalate the issue to the Network Operations team.
Step 9: Step 9 - Document all findings and actions taken in the incident record.
Step 10: Step 10 - Monitor the server for any further issues after resolution.
technical_details: The incident affects server XYZ, which is part of the network infrastructure. Logs indicate potential issues with the network interface card (NIC) and connectivity errors. Configuration settings for the network port were last modified on 2025-09-25.
complete_description: The incident involves a network port hung on server XYZ, leading to connectivity issues. Technical analysis shows potential NIC problems and configuration changes prior to the incident. Recommended actions include verifying the port status, reviewing logs, and restarting the network interface to restore connectivity.
